label: CiRA CORE → Classroom Web
info: Receives CiRA CORE counts from broker.emqx.io:1883, spu/classroom/room/person. Validates counts and forwards nonretained telemetry to the existing web topic. No AC commands or automatic control. Keep only one copy of this bridge active.

name: CiRA / Web • broker.emqx.io
CiRA MQTT → ตรวจจำนวนคน → เว็บเดิม
info: CiRA publishes {"total_people":2} to spu/classroom/room/person every 1–5 seconds, retain=false. Web listens to spu/classroom/cira on WSS port 8084. MQTT input and output use the same broker; input/output topics must differ.
